hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: My Skills waiting exception: While awaiting an active implementer, reviewer, or long-running verification command, use event-driven waits. In this state, this instruction replaces the default requirements to provide commentary every 60 seconds and avoid waits longer than 60 seconds. Agree up front on milestones, immediate decision/blocker/failure reporting, and a credible stall deadline. Choose a timeout up to that deadline, often about 30 minutes for substantial work, within the tool's maximum; messages, completion, or user input can end it early. Give an update before waiting. Keep routine command polling and verbose evidence inside the executor or an existing cheaper capable worker; return completion, failure, a material decision, or agreed milestone/stall evidence to the parent. A persistent exec cell still causes model turns when observed: avoid yield_control, notify, recurring status output, and short outer exec/wait windows merely to report a running process. Preserve user interruption and runtime limits. For supervised implementation, use a shared writable progress log. Only the implementer writes progress entries; the parent replies directly. Every child direct message and final handoff specifies log-read: none when self-contained, or log-read: <absolute-path>:<start-line>-<end-line> with verified 1-based line numbers when log context is needed. Read only the requested range; an event or timeout does not itself require a log read. Ask the child for a range if more context is needed. On a child decision or blocker, follow its log-read instruction and reply with send_message for an active child or followup_task for the same idle child before waiting again. Never just return to waiting or record the parent's response in the log. On child completion, follow its log-read instruction, then begin acceptance. On command completion, verify the exact revision, command, exit status, and material acceptance evidence. At the stall deadline, use the owning workflow's recovery procedure without automatically reading logs. An empty timeout before that deadline calls directly for another wait. Outside these waiting states, retain normal communication guidance. This exception does not authorize delegation or change ownership, acceptance, writer settlement, or approval requirements.
